title: Granite.Trust Policy Tools: Shareable, Actionable Policies for Generative AI Applications
abstract: arXiv:2608.23870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When it comes to safety policies for generative AI, one size does not fit all. Each organization and use case needs to mitigate different risks depending on the application context, regulatory environment, organizational values, and user personas. Yet, existing policy specification approaches are designed for traditional access control and fail to capture the nuances of GenAI application: the enforcement of content-based constraints.   We present two contributions to address this gap: (1) the Actionable Policy schema, a YAML-based format for specifying what model responses can and cannot contain. The schema enables exception-based policy governance, proposing exceptions to track policy violations; (2) synthetic data generation pipeline that produces policy-aligned training data for model alignment and testing, and a set of tools to help define the schema and enforce policy. translated_title: Granite.Trust 策略工具：为生成式人工智能应用提供可共享、可操作的策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23870v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在生成式人工智能的安全策略方面，没有一种通用方案适用于所有情况。每个组织和使用场景都需要根据应用上下文、监管环境、组织价值观和用户画像来缓解不同的风险。然而，现有的策略规范方法是为传统访问控制设计的，未能捕捉生成式AI应用的细微差别：基于内容的约束执行。我们提出了两项贡献来弥补这一差距：（1）可操作策略模式，一种基于YAML的格式，用于指定模型响应可以包含和不能包含的内容。该模式支持基于异常的策略治理，提出异常以跟踪策略违规；（2）合成数据生成管道，用于生成与策略对齐的训练数据，以进行模型对齐和测试，以及一套工具来帮助定义模式和执行策略。这些共同使组织能够一次性指定策略。
tldr: 本文提出了一种YAML格式的可操作策略模式和合成数据生成管道，使组织能够为生成式AI应用一次性定义并执行可共享、可操作的内容安全策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an actionable policy schema in YAML format and a synthetic data generation pipeline, enabling organizations to define and enforce shareable, actionable content safety policies for generative AI applications at once.
